main_text.p: Hęc si possum ego lentus intueri,
Quin vos mens bona, sanitas, salúsque
Sic me viuere, sic mori suaue est.
main_text.head: Ad Antonivm Goveanvm.
main_text.p: Si quisquam Goveane fas mihi esset
Et te nostro ego Teuio inuiderem,
Sed cum me nihil inuidere sit fas,
Si fas est quod amor dolórque cogit,
Vterque vt mihi sed cito reppendat
Hoc prauum ob facinus, malúmque poenas:
Cœlúm Dijs ego non suum inuidebo,

page.notes: Marginal ink marks and show-through at the right edge are not transcribed. The word "Sed" at the lower right is treated as a catchword. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the scan's faintness (e.g. "Innidere", "reppendat", "Teuióue"); no [?] markers were added to keep the transcription readable.
